milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the orange concrete structure (centered at spawn-relative [9, 0, -4]) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 ensures the player actively walked toward the target rather than satisfying the condition from spawn (~10 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are actually looking at the orange concrete. Verified in sandbox: orange concrete is NOT visible from spawn direction, so the agent must explore to find it.
